subject: DataHarbor pilot engagement plan & access checklist
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@dataharbor.com>, Andrew Park <andrew.park@dataharbor.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-12T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: pilot goals and quick next steps

Hi Emily / Andrew,

Thanks again for taking time earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery so everyone has the same expectations and next steps.

Pain points you shared:
- Inconsistent LLM inference latency during peak business hours (spikes to 700–900ms on 95th)
- High per-request cost for reranking/semantic search on existing provider
- Security & audit requirements: request-level logs, team-based access controls

Objectives for the pilot (agreed):
1) Validate a production-quality reranker and search embedding pipeline with 95th percentile latency < 350ms.
2) Maintain comparable or better result quality vs today's baseline (NDCG@10 within 5%).
3) Measure unit cost and provide configuration recommendations to hit budget target (~$0.002/token equivalent for gen workload).

Proposed pilot scope (2–4 weeks):
- Ingest a 20k prompt/queries sample set and 5k labeled relevance pairs
- Run A/B evaluation against current provider using our prompt set and eval harness
- Provide a short runbook for production cutover and cost optimizations

Owners / roles:
- DataHarbor: Emily (Product) — access + prompt set + labeled evals; Andrew (Eng) — env & network
- Redwood: Marcus (AE) — pilot coordination; Connor (Solutions Eng) — technical setup and model selection; Evelyn (Customer Success) — success criteria and rollout plan

Immediate asks / access checklist (what we need to start):
- S3 bucket or secure share with sample prompts + labels (read-only)
- IAM/service account or an allowlisted IP for short-lived API keys
- Procurement contact for a one-time SOW and NDA (email ok)

Proposed timeline:
- Start window: May 3–7 (you mentioned the first week of May looked good)
- Pilot run: 2–3 weeks
- Evaluation & recommendations: 1 week after run

I've attached a draft SOW and a quick pilot checklist. Can you confirm by EOD tomorrow that the timeline and owners look right and share the sample dataset location and procurement contact?

Thanks,

Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
m: (555) 555-0199
marcus.lin@redwood.com

Subject: Pilot kickoff recap, owners, and technical checklist

On Mon, Apr 12, 2027 at 2:26 PM Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@dataharbor.com> wrote:
> Thanks Marcus — this lines up with what we discussed.
> ...

Thanks for confirming, Emily — following up with a slightly more detailed kickoff recap and explicit checklist so the ops and procurement teams have something concrete to work from.

Pilot acceptance criteria / metrics (how we'll measure success):
- Latency: 95th percentile generation/rerank latency < 350ms under pilot traffic profile
- Quality: NDCG@10 within 5% of your current baseline on the provided labeled set
- Cost: Per-unit inference cost analysis with suggestions to reach your budget target (goal ~ $0.002/token equivalent for gen workloads; we'll show trade-offs)

Prompt set and evals:
- Please include a sample set of ~20k queries and at least 5k labeled relevance pairs; we'll run a blind A/B evaluation and return a report with NDCG, precision@k, and qualitative failure modes.
- Connor will own the eval harness and will need the label schema (CSV format preferred) and any scoring scripts you use.

Technical kickoff checklist (items for DataHarbor to provide):
1) S3 path (or secure share) with sample prompts + labels (read-only) + a sample of raw documents for embedding validation
2) Allowlist: CIDR/IPs to allow for short-lived test keys OR an ops contact for temporary credentials
3) Service account or short-lived API key for Redwood test-run (we do not store keys beyond the pilot)
4) SOC2 report (PDF) and basic retention requirements for request logs

Timeline & milestones:
- May 3: kickoff (tech sync + access validated)
- May 4–18: ingest + run A/B evaluation (Connor to manage runs)
- May 19–24: analysis + recommendations (Evelyn to lead)
- May 25–28: final recap & SOW/production handoff discussion

Attachments & links:
- Draft SOW (attached)
- Pilot checklist (attached)
- Shared doc: https://drive.google.com/example/pilot-charter

If Sarah or procurement needs a different cadence for contract review, let me know and we'll adapt. Once you confirm access and the procurement contact, Connor and I will schedule the kickoff.

Thanks,

Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
